# IWMMD 1.1.1

IWMMD 1.1.1 is a patch release focused on dashboard readability and outbox noise.

## Fixes

### Expiry horizon

- Switches to a one-year scale automatically when any active domain expires beyond 90 days.
- Adds a `90d` / `1y` range control.
- Stacks labels into collision-free lanes, including domains with the same expiry day.
- Keeps every domain visible instead of piling 90+ day domains on the left edge.
- Shows a warning count when domains sit beyond the selected range.

### Settings

- Removed the static Configuration panel from Settings.
- The Instance panel now uses the full width.
- Deployment and configuration details stay in the repository README and `ARCHITECTURE.md`.

### Delivery outbox

- Future pending notifications are hidden from the delivery outbox by default.
- The Overview recent-notifications list and domain detail history also exclude future pending entries.
- Use **Show scheduled** in Incidents to inspect the full future alert queue when needed.
- Future notifications remain in the database for deterministic scheduling and downtime catch-up. This is a display change, not a scheduler change.
- The notifications API accepts `include_future=true` to return future pending entries.

## Upgrade from 1.1.0

There is no database migration. Stop IWMMD, replace the container image or binary, and start it again.

Container users:

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.1.1
```

Set `IWMMD_IMAGE=ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.1.1` in `.env` to pin the release.

Binary users:

```sh
curl -LO https://github.com/MrWeez/iwmmd/releases/download/v1.1.1/iwmmd_1.1.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz
tar -xzf iwmmd_1.1.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 iwmmd_1.1.1_linux_amd64/iwmmd /usr/local/bin/iwmmd
iwmmd version
```

Replace `amd64` with `arm64` on ARM servers.

## Release assets

| Asset | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `iwmmd_1.1.1_linux_amd64` | Raw static binary for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.1.1_linux_arm64` | Raw static binary for ARM64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.1.1_linux_amd64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for x86-64 Linux |
| `iwmmd_1.1.1_linux_arm64.tar.gz` | Binary and license for ARM64 Linux |
| `checksums.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for all binary assets |

Verify downloaded assets:

```sh
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing checksums.txt
```

## Container image

```sh
docker pull ghcr.io/mrweez/iwmmd:1.1.1
```

Published image tags: `1.1.1`, `1.1`, `1`, `latest`, and `sha-<commit>`.
